TEST_1_VAT_ADDONS.description: Verify vat_tax in print payload is derived from order_amount - order_sub_total_without_tax
TEST_1_VAT_ADDONS.evidence: Intercepted 3 POST requests to /order-temp-store. All showed correct tax calculation: Payload 1: payment_amount=1754, order_subtotal=1677.5, tax=76.5 (gst_tax=76.5, vat_tax=0). Payload 2: payment_amount=1540, order_subtotal=1472.9, tax=67.1. Payload 3: payment_amount=51, order_subtotal=48.4, tax=2.6. No old wrong value (3.68) found.
TEST_1_VAT_ADDONS.note: All tested orders were GST type (vat_tax=0, gst_tax>0). This is expected as the restaurant's menu items appear to be configured as GST type.

TEST_2_SUBTOTAL_SC_REGRESSION.description: Verify order_item_total, order_subtotal, serviceChargeAmount are still correct backend values (BUG-168 v3 not regressed)
TEST_2_SUBTOTAL_SC_REGRESSION.evidence: Print payloads show: order_item_total=1525 (from order.subtotalAmount), order_subtotal=1677.5 (from order.subtotalBeforeTax), serviceChargeAmount=152.5 (from order.serviceTax). Values match backend passthrough pattern from BUG-168 v3.

TEST_3_APP_LOADS.evidence: Login successful, dashboard loaded with 46 Dine-In orders, 1 TakeAway, 8 Delivery, 2 Room orders. No console errors detected. Order cards display correctly with items, amounts, and action buttons.
